title: VPN asks for password again and again
description: Every time I connect to the VPN it asks for my password again, even though I type it correctly. It started after my password change yesterday.

title: Websites not loading but Teams works
description: Internal websites do not load by name in the browser, but Teams and Outlook work fine. Using the IP address directly works.

title: Report query timing out
description: The weekly sales report in SQL Server times out after 30 seconds with 'Timeout expired'. It used to finish in a few seconds.

title: Cannot log in to Oracle after password reset
description: After my Oracle account password was reset I get ORA-01017 invalid username/password when I open the finance tool.

title: Keyboard types wrong characters
description: My keyboard types @ instead of " and some keys are swapped since this morning.

title: Laptop freezes with high memory
description: My laptop freezes for a minute several times a day. Task manager shows memory at 98% when Chrome and Excel are open.

title: Emails stuck in outbox
description: Emails with attachments stay in the Outlook outbox and are never sent. Small emails without attachments go out fine.

title: Windows update fails repeatedly
description: Windows update fails to install with error 0x80070002 and retries every night.

title: Antivirus blocks the expense tool
description: The antivirus quarantines the expense tool installer and I cannot submit my expenses.

title: Access to the procurement app
description: I moved to the purchasing team and need access to the internal procurement application.

title: No IP address on the docking station
description: When I plug the laptop into the docking station the wired network gets a 169.254 address and I have no network.

title: DB2 batch job fails at night
description: The nightly DB2 batch job fails with SQL0911N deadlock or timeout and the morning reports are empty.
